name: THE FUNERAL NOTICE
note: EXTRACTED from docs/118-objects-the-lines.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 245). Do not edit: change doc 118 and re-run. Handed over by Frame; posted on Main Street, which begins the funeral day.

LOOK_AT.say: 'MEMORIAL FOR E. PIKE, LATE. ALL WELCOME. REFRESHMENTS.' The ink is still wet, and so is the sentiment.
repeat: REFRESHMENTS is in larger type than PIKE. Mr. Frame knows his readers.
It does not say who is paying. Notices of mine never do.

LISTEN_TO.say: Wet paper. It sticks to itself like a secret.
repeat: Nothing. It will be louder on a wall.
A drip, onto my boot. Mr. Pike is leaving his mark at last.
